limitations: This is an independent technical review, not a blind sequential readability review.

PyTorch documentation is pinned to official 2.8 pages; executed runtime is 2.14.1+cpu, git 5c4886908584029761b579af026dcfb627c84070. API behavior and storage sizes were actually exercised on that runtime.
Existing GPU run provenance reports PyTorch 2.14.1+cu126 and Python 3.13.3. The current review uses CPU Python 3.13.5 and does not reproduce that run.

The three private learned checkpoint binaries were not downloaded, loaded, copied or remeasured. File bytes and SHA are original JSON measurements and agree internally with the storage accounting and original generation code.

Randomly initialized same-configuration model instances establish storage shapes/counts only. They do not establish accuracy, generation behavior, latency, memory savings of an entire process, or quality of trained weights.
No GPU execution, training, dataset/model download, whole-model score reevaluation, body/figure edit, commit, push or subagent creation.
